title: 1812 Prairie's tall south chimney stands near the front
items: The tall chimney on the south wall of George H. Wheeler's house at 1812 Prairie Avenue now stands near the front, about 2 m behind it, and rises to 16.8 m. It used to stand 6 m back and 0.8 m higher. A second photograph, taken about 1955 from a little south of the house, saw the chimney from a new angle. Comparing it with Albert Levy's photograph from the 1880s or 1890s fixed where the chimney stands. The 1955 photograph also shows a second tall chimney behind the gable's north side. Levy's photograph shows only open sky there, so that chimney is not built for 1904.
